home.lead: Support from pregnancy through postpartum and baby care.
home.about_body: HerMamaAI demonstrates pregnancy education, postpartum wellbeing, emotional wellness, healthcare navigation and childhood immunization planning. It is in demonstration and evaluation and has not been clinically validated.

preg.intro: Regular antenatal visits help your maternity team monitor your health and your baby’s development. Ask which appointments, tests and vaccinations are appropriate for you.
post.intro: Recovery continues beyond discharge, and serious complications can arise even after an uncomplicated birth. Keep your recommended postnatal appointments.
well.intro: Pregnancy and new motherhood can bring many emotions. You deserve support and space to talk about how you feel.
calm.intro: A gentle, optional pause for mothers and mothers-to-be. Play at your own pace, or simply rest. No scores, competition, or personal information required.
learn.intro: A simple collection of topics to discuss with qualified maternity professionals.
baby.intro: This is an educational immunization planning demonstration, not a medical record or official vaccination schedule. Confirm vaccines and timing with a qualified provider.
find.intro: Explore a starter directory of government-listed teaching hospitals in Abuja and other Nigerian cities. This is a planning aid, not a clinical referral or booking service.
mama.intro: Care does not end at childbirth. Explore supportive postpartum information and prepare for follow-up with your maternity team.
ac.intro: Experimental, rule-based maternal wellness habit support • Educational demonstration

ui.Antenatal visits may include blood pr: Antenatal visits may include blood pressure measurement, laboratory tests, screening, fetal growth monitoring and discussion of symptoms. What is appropriate depends on your stage of pregnancy, medical history and local guidance.
ui.Discuss where you plan to give birth,: Discuss where you plan to give birth, how you will travel there, whom to contact, what to pack and who can support you. Review emergency arrangements with your maternity team.
ui.Recovery varies after vaginal birth a: Recovery varies after vaginal birth and caesarean birth. Ask your clinician about pain control, incision or perineal care, expected bleeding, safe activity and when to seek assessment for changes.
ui.Discuss antenatal visits, recommended: Discuss antenatal visits, recommended screening, medicines, nutrition, baby's movement, delivery plans and emergency transport with your maternity team.
ui.HerMamaAI is a prototype for general: HerMamaAI is a prototype for general education and personal planning. It does not diagnose illness, monitor symptoms, send appointments to clinics or replace medical advice.

ui.**Two different things:** Your appoin: **Two different things:** Your appointments are dates you enter from your care plan. Suggested milestones below are educational topics only — not booked appointments or a personalized medical schedule.
ui.Privacy: entries are held in this app: Privacy: entries are held in this app session only. They are not saved to a database or sent to a clinic. Avoid entering personal medical information or identifying clinic details on a shared device.
ui.Enter the appointment date and time g: Enter the appointment date and time given by your maternity team, select Add to my calendar, then use the .ics download button. Open the downloaded file in your phone's calendar and confirm that the event appears. The exported event requests a reminder 1 day before the appointment; whether an alert appears depends on your phone calendar app and notification settings. HerMamaAI itself does not send notifications. For appointments less than 1 day away, set a suitable reminder manually in your calendar.
ui.Bring any maternity notes you have, a: Bring any maternity notes you have, a list of medicines or supplements, questions you want answered, and any instructions your maternity team has given you. Ask a trusted person to help with transport if needed.

safety.emergency_translation_notice: Emergency information is shown in English while translated medical guidance awaits qualified review. If you have serious symptoms, seek immediate in-person medical help; do not wait for an app response.
safety.review_status: This educational prototype does not provide diagnoses, emergency response, or personalized medical advice. Healthcare-practitioner review of the app does not establish validation of these draft translations.
ui.**Important:** Being listed by the Fe: **Important:** Being listed by the Federal Ministry of Health does not mean HerMamaAI has verified maternity services, opening hours, emergency capacity, precise map location or current operations. **None of these hospitals is claimed as a HerMamaAI partner.** Confirm details with the facility before a non-urgent visit.
ui.**City not listed?** This starter dir: **City not listed?** This starter directory covers the cities represented by the ministry's teaching-hospital list, not every Nigerian city or maternity facility. Contact your local primary healthcare centre or state health authority for other options. In an emergency, use the nearest appropriate emergency service instead of travelling to a distant listed hospital.
ui.Source: Federal Ministry of Health an: Source: Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, Teaching Hospitals directory. Directory needs periodic rechecking, independent service verification and clinical review before real-world pilot use.

ui.**Urgent warning signs:** Heavy bleed: **Urgent warning signs:** Heavy bleeding, chest pain, trouble breathing, seizures, severe headache or vision changes, fainting, fever with severe illness, or thoughts of harming yourself or your baby. Seek emergency medical care immediately.
safety.mamacare_physical: Contact your maternity care team promptly. For severe or sudden symptoms, seek emergency care now.
safety.mamacare_emotional: Contact a qualified healthcare professional and someone you trust. If you may harm yourself or your baby, seek emergency help now and do not stay alone.
